conditions.additional_experiments: Original transverse-contraction curves may be supplied separately in transverse_curves; their spatial sampling and branch tags are not reported. Pear-loop observations are not supplied
conditions.boundary_condition: Two clamped ends; horizontal displacement control, total force measured; transverse deformation is nonuniform
conditions.conditioning: Temperature, relative humidity and conditioning duration not supplied
conditions.rate: Displacement rate and sample timestamps not supplied
conditions.source_processing: Author CSV; preprocessing and instrument-level rawness unspecified
conditions.uncertainty: Replicate identities, instrument uncertainty and population bounds not supplied

source.note: Sperl et al. (2022), section 4.3 and Figure 4; 100 mm free gauge excluding clamps, 60 mm width; horizontal displacement-controlled clamped stretch with measured force. Source angular origin is weft (0 degrees), bias (45 degrees), warp (90 degrees).

unverified_model_assumptions: Planar deformation and exclusion of out-of-plane buckling must be explicitly chosen by the consumer
Ideal no-slip grip locking is a model approximation; clamp slip/compliance is not measured here
A membrane/plane-stress law and quasi-static equilibrium are modeling assumptions, not properties inferred by this acquisition
